alt: A smiling young woman in a navy tee and jeans sits on a brick ledge by a white column, holding open a signed picture book.
A couple laughs nose to nose as he dips her in a grassy field, both backlit by a low golden sun.
A smiling graduate in a white off-shoulder dress and bright stoles leans against a carved stone pillar, one red heel kicked up.
Two graduates in navy gowns stand in a white doorway between tall columns, raising their caps overhead in celebration.
A man in a plaid flannel kisses the cheek of a smiling woman in a white sweater dress and cowboy boots on a dry grassy lawn.
A young woman sits in tall grass and kisses the nose of a bay horse, both glowing in warm backlight from a low sun.
A smiling young woman in a polka dot dress leans on a white column, a black graduation gown slung over her shoulder.
A beaming graduate in a white dress, purple stole, and colorful cords sits on a stone wall and holds her cap high.
A graduate in a navy cap peeks over a picture book titled "Junie B. Jones Is a Graduation Girl", only her eyes showing.
A smiling graduate in a black gown and gold stole stands on a turf field in front of empty bleachers and a brick press box.
A graduate in a white dress and magenta stole looks back over her shoulder with a bright smile in front of arched wooden doors.
A woman in a white dress and tan heels walks away holding a copy of "Oh, the Places You'll Go!" at her side.
Two hands clasp tightly over a field of glowing golden grass, delicate bracelets catching the warm backlight.
Two friends sit cross legged on a green lawn laughing, one in pink pants and the other in a blue "TEACH" tee.
A couple rests forehead to forehead, both laughing, his plaid flannel against her cream sweater in soft overcast light.
A smiling young woman in a polka dot dress leans on a tall black post clock with one arm stretched out wide.

A smiling graduate in a white dress hugs a stack of children's books, a handprint painted stole around her neck.
A hand holds a navy cap with a "2026" tassel charm against a navy gown, red crested stole, and colorful cords.
Two friends hold up navy tassels with "2026" charms, showing matching small cross tattoos on their wrists.
A graduate in a white sequined dress looks back over her shoulder, colorful cords draped down her back, before a splashing fountain.
A cheerful young woman in a "TEACH" tee sits on a brick wall beside a row of children's books, one arm raised.
A smiling young woman in a polka dot dress and gold stole sits on sunlit concrete steps, leaning back on one hand.
A couple kisses in a dramatic dip, her white lace dress flowing, as the sun sets behind trees and water.
A graduate in a white dress and handprint painted stole tosses a red apple, mouth open in delight, on a green lawn.
A grinning woman in a cream sweater wraps her arms around a man in a camo cap as he kisses her cheek.
A smiling graduate in a navy gown, red stole, and cords stands in a white doorway framed by two tall columns.
A smiling young woman in a cream "NICU" tee with a stethoscope around her neck stands on a sunlit lawn.
A woman's hands rest clasped around a man's neck as they embrace, a ring visible on her finger.
A graduate in a navy gown with a red stole and colorful cords gazes off to the side in front of a brick building.
A graduate in a white dress and magenta stole tosses her cap and kicks up one heel on wide stone steps.
Hands hold open a copy of "Oh, the Places You'll Go!" filled with colorful handwritten notes.
Crossed legs in white slingback heels, a black tassel with a "2026" charm dangling from one heel.
A woman in a white dress raises joined hands as a man smiles behind her in a sunlit hay field.
A young woman in a white dress sits on concrete steps, chin in hand, holding a cap decorated with a photo collage.
A smiling young woman in a white sundress leans her cheek against a bay horse as sunbeams stream through the trees.
A couple kisses in front of a tall fountain and white stone railing, her heel kicked up behind her.
